declarations.description: Multiline text input with native resizing, helper text, error feedback and a character counter.
declarations.name: Textarea

slots.description: Rich helper content below the field; error-text takes precedence when invalid.
slots.name: supporting-text

members.name: value
members.description: Current text. Set this property to update the value programmatically.

members.name: name
members.description: Name forwarded to the native control.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name for the native textarea.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name forwarded from the host.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Hint shown when empty.

members.name: rows
members.description: Visible number of text lines.

members.name: cols
members.description: Native width hint, used when no CSS width is set.

members.name: resize
members.description: Allowed user resize directions.

members.name: wrap
members.description: Native line wrapping mode.

members.name: autocomplete
members.description: Browser autocomplete hint.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Prevents editing and removes the control from keyboard navigation.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Prevents editing while allowing selection.

members.name: required
members.description: Requires a nonempty value for native validation.

members.name: maxLength
members.description: Maximum character count; -1 means unlimited.

members.name: minLength
members.description: Minimum character count; -1 means no minimum.

members.name: error
members.description: Displays the error border and error text.

members.name: errorText
members.description: Message displayed when error is true.

members.name: help
members.description: Helper text below the control.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the native textarea.

members.name: select
members.description: Selects all text.

members.name: setSelectionRange
members.description: Selects a range of text using native UTF-16 character offsets.

members.name: isDirty
members.description: Whether the user has edited the value since the last reset.

members.name: reset
members.description: Restores the value attribute and clears the error state.

members.name: checkValidity
members.description: Checks the native textarea constraints. Await updateComplete after changing properties.

members.name: reportValidity
members.description: Shows the browser's validation feedback.

members.name: setCustomValidity
members.description: Sets or clears the native validation message.

events.description: Fired on each edit, after value is updated.
events.name: input

events.description: Fired when an edit is committed.
events.name: change
